referenceConvention: Use each exact supplied ring traversal and stated Haworth viewing layout. In that standard orientation the D-glucose C2/C3/C4 oxygen pattern is down/up/down and D-fructofuranose C3/C4 hydroxy pattern is up/down; the C5 hydroxymethyl side is up. Alpha/beta refers to the relative anomeric oxygen versus the configurational reference side, not the absolute page top.

assignments.anomer: AC1-Og down opposite AC5-AC6 up: alpha-D-glucopyranosyl
assignments.glycosidicSite: AC1-Og-BC4; BC4-Og down replaces the normal C4 hydroxy substituent; no extra hydroxyl on AC1 or BC4.

assignments.anomer: BC1-OH down opposite BC5-BC6 up: alpha reducing-end anomer as labelled
assignments.freeCenter: BC1 remains a hemiacetal carbon with ring oxygen, OH, carbon and H; drawing the alpha anomer does not block ring opening or make the anomer fixed in aqueous equilibrium.

assignments.anomer: GC1-Og down opposite GC5-GC6 up: alpha-D-glucopyranosyl
FC2-Og up on the same side as FC5-FC6 up: beta-D-fructofuranosyl; FC2-FC1 down; FC2 has no H
assignments.glycosidicSite: GC1-Og-FC2 connects both anomeric centres through exactly one oxygen; FC2 has ring-O, C3, C1 and bridge-O single bonds.

inference: The supplied configurations represent alpha-D-Glcp-(1->4)-alpha-D-Glcp and alpha-D-Glcp-(1->2)-beta-D-Fruf. No mannose/galactose epimer, missing terminal hydroxymethyl group, duplicate bridge oxygen or pentavalent carbon is introduced.
